description: 2025 Cadillac Lyriq (GM Ultium) diagnostics. WORK IN PROGRESS — the Ultium HV battery data is on a 29-bit CAN bus and is not yet publicly reverse-engineered. Only generic J1979 signals are confirmed. Use the reverse-engineering toolkit (Phase 5) to discover BMS DIDs and add them here.

provenance.derivedFrom: Confirmed on a live 2025 Lyriq (VIN 1GYKPTRL5SZ302606) via a Pi BLE bridge + Viecar ELM327 clone. Transport + ECU map verified; HV-BMS analog DIDs (SOC/V/A/temp) still pending. See docs/lyriq-re-log.md.
provenance.confidence: Protocol (ISO 15765-4 29/500) and battery ECU address (40) CONFIRMED on-vehicle. J1979 baseline: high. Specific SOC/voltage/temp DIDs: NOT yet identified.
provenance.license: J1979 signals are public-domain protocol facts.

protocol.note: CONFIRMED on-vehicle: ISO 15765-4 CAN 29-bit/500k, force with ATSP7 (auto-detect ATSP0 FAILS on the Lyriq). Battery/propulsion controller (BECM) is ECU 40: request header 18DA40F1, response filter 18DAF140. A Viecar ELM327 clone DID handle 29-bit multiframe here, though an STN adapter (OBDLink CX/MX+) is still recommended for reliability.

ecuMap._comment: ECUs seen answering the 0100 functional broadcast (18DB33F1) on this Lyriq. Battery data lives on ECU 40.

_unconfirmed_hv_bms._comment: Candidate signals to be discovered/validated by the UDS DID scanner + CAN sniffer. Do NOT load these until confirmed on a real Lyriq. Populated as reverse engineering progresses.
